query: I have 2 days in Luxor. What should I do?
answer:
**Day 1 — The Wonders of Ancient Egypt**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Valley of the Kings** — 3 hours — Start your day early to explore the tombs of ancient pharaohs, including Tutankhamun's tomb. Arrive at opening time to avoid crowds and the midday heat. 
  - 📍 Address: Valley of the Kings, Luxor
  - 💰 Entry Fee: 300 EGP (approx. $9.75)
  - ![Valley of the Kings](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Vall%C3%A9e_des_rois_%28Vall%C3%A9e_des_reines%29_%2840077562673%29.jpg/800px-Vall%C3%A9e_des_rois_%28Vall%C3%A9e_des_reines%29_%2840077562673%29.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Eatery in the West Bank** — Enjoy traditional Egyptian dishes like grilled chicken or kofta.

**Afternoon (13:00–17:00)**
• **Deir el-Medina** — 2 hours — After lunch, visit this ancient village of artisans who built the royal tombs. The beautifully decorated private tombs provide a glimpse into the lives of these skilled workers.
  - 📍 Address: PJH2+37, Al Qarna, Luxor Governorate
  - 💰 Entry Fee: 100 EGP (approx. $3.25)
  - ![Deir el-Medina](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6b/Deir_el-Medina%2C_Luxor%2C_Egipto%2C_2022-04-03%2C_DD_18.jpg/3840px-Deir_el-Medina%2C_Luxor%2C_Egipto%2C_2022-04-03%2C_DD_18.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Dinner at a Riverside Restaurant** — Relax and enjoy traditional Egyptian cuisine with views of the Nile.

---

**Day 2 — Cultural and Historical Exploration**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Luxor Temple** — 2 hours — Begin your day with a visit to this magnificent temple, beautifully illuminated in the morning light. 
  - 📍 Address: Luxor City, Luxor
  - 💰 Entry Fee: 200 EGP (approx. $6.50)
  - ![Luxor Temple](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/05/Luxor_Temple%2C_Luxor%2C_Egipto%2C_2022-04-02%2C_DD_18.jpg/800px-Luxor_Temple%2C_Luxor%2C_Egipto%2C_2022-04-02%2C_DD_18.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Café on the Corniche** — Take a break and try a local specialty like ful medames with bread.

**Afternoon (13:00–17:00)**
• **Luxor Museum** — 2 hours — Spend your afternoon at this world-class museum that houses artifacts from the Theban temples and necropolis. It's a great way to escape the heat and learn about Luxor's rich history.
  - 📍 Address: Kornish Al Nile, Luxor City
  - 💰 Entry Fee: 140 EGP (approx. $4.50)
  - ![Luxor Museum](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/luxor-museum-0-1781571251.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Stroll along the Luxor Corniche** — Enjoy the beautiful waterfront promenade with cafes and local shops. You might also consider a felucca ride on the Nile to end your day.

---

**Travel Tips:**
- Wear comfortable shoes; you'll be doing a lot of walking!
- Carry water and sunscreen, especially for outdoor sites.
- Consider hiring a knowledgeable local guide for deeper insights into the history and culture.
